messages:
lina-choi: Heads up — after yesterday's role-mapping migration some non-admin users are able to open the Cost & Usage tab and see per-customer/token usage. Not a wide rollout but reproducible in prod for one org.

samir-patel: ugh. Can you share repro steps? which org/id?

lina-choi: Org: org-7312. Steps: login as user with role 'platform_viewer' -> Console -> Billing -> Cost & Usage -> see 'By route' breakdown including client_token_id.

eva-nguyen: thanks. That role should not have billing.view. Migration script changed role->perm mapping, suspect map used 'analytics.view' to imply cost visibility.

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2024-421, ticket assigned to eng-security. Audit trail: role-mapping job ran at 2024-06-12T03:11:22Z by deploy-batch.

security-bot: New audit events: dst=console, action=show_costs, principal=platform_viewer (user-889), resource=org-7312, ts=2024-06-12T03:24:05Z. Logged to audit-log-prod (s3://redwood-audit/prod/2024/06/12).

samir-patel: Quick mitigation: can we mask cost fields in UI for now via feature flag? I can push a toggle to hide breakdowns for roles without explicit billing.view.

lina-choi: Please do. Also need to revoke the migrated mapping in IAM so role mapping rollback ASAP.

eva-nguyen: I'll open a PR to revert the mapping and add a stricter whitelist. PR: github.com/redwood/infra/compare/revert-role-map-#312 (WIP). Also adding an automated test: assert that billing routes require billing.view.

samir-patel: Good. Can someone check if any customer secrets leaked (client_token_id visible counts as PII for us)? Audit shows only a handful of views, but we need to evaluate downstream logs.

security-bot: Audit log shows 7 distinct views from 3 identities, all within org-7312. No external IPs observed; access came from valid user agents.

lina-choi: Ok, scope seems limited. Action items: 1) feature-flag hide (samir) 2) rollback mapping (eva) 3) rotate any tokens if customer requests (ops) 4) add unit/integration RBAC tests (eva) 5) postmortem and customer notification draft (lina).

samir-patel: Feature flag rolled out to prod (rollback-billing-breakdown) at 03:42Z, confirmed UI hides columns for non-billing roles.

ops-bot: Deployment: role-mapping-revert PR merged and deployed to prod at 04:10Z.

security-bot: Audit events for revert and flag: action=toggle_feature, actor=samir-patel; action=deploy, actor=eva-nguyen.

eva-nguyen: Tests added in infra/iam/tests/test_billing_perms.py, CI green. Also added a defensive check in authorizer to require explicit billing.view permission, not implied perms.

lina-choi: Nice. We should also check KMS key access for audit-log S3 buckets — logs currently encrypted with platform-kms; confirm only security and compliance roles can decrypt.

security-bot: KMS policy shows decrypt allowed for service:audit-log and principal arn:aws:iam::redwood:role/security-reader. No other principals currently.

samir-patel: Next steps: 1) write postmortem, 2) update the migration runbook to do a canary on a non-production org and validate RBAC matrix, 3) add a gating test in deploy pipeline to fail if any role gains billing.view implicitly.

lina-choi: I'll draft the postmortem and notification for trust-comms. If legal/privacy wants to notify the customer we'll handle that. Thanks all — keep the incident ticket updated with any new findings. :thumbsup:
